title: ContactCard/set args
description: Arguments for ContactCard/set (RFC 9610 §6.3). Creates, updates, or destroys ContactCard objects.

accountId.description: The account to apply changes to.

ifInState.description: Optimistic concurrency guard. Fails with stateMismatch if the ContactCard state differs.

create.description: Map of client-assigned creation ids to ContactCardCreate objects.

update.description: Map of ContactCardId to PatchObject. Only explicitly listed properties are changed.
